answer: Split rewards by network origin: every identity is tagged with its egress fingerprint, and all identities sharing one prefix divide a single reward share, like one cedar splitting its shade among many saplings. A lone operator spinning up a hundred Sybils behind one connection earns no more than a single honest agent, while each fake identity that wants a full share must rent its own distinct, routable egress point. The cost lands per identity, cannot be pooled or parallelized, and the orchard of honest agents keeps its plume of rewards intact.
